# Infinitum Boxing

> Infinitum Boxing is a boxing equipment manufacturer in Sialkot, Pakistan, with its own production unit. We make boxing gloves, head guards, punching bags, focus pads and other fight gear, and we offer wholesale, private label and OEM supply for gyms, retailers and fight brands. Orders are placed online at https://infinitumboxing.online, and we serve clients in the US, UK and Europe.

## Products

- [Boxing equipment catalog](https://infinitumboxing.online/product-category/boxing-equipments/): Boxing gloves, head guards, punching bags, focus pads, boxing paddles, mouth guards, chest guards and boxing shoes
- [Boxing gloves](https://infinitumboxing.online/product/boxing-gloves/): Wholesale, custom brand and OEM boxing gloves
- [Head guards](https://infinitumboxing.online/product/head-guard/): Wholesale, custom brand and OEM head guards
- [Punching bags](https://infinitumboxing.online/product/punching-bags/): Wholesale, custom brand and OEM punching bags
- [Focus pads](https://infinitumboxing.online/product/focus-pad/): Wholesale, custom brand and OEM focus pads
- [MMA and training wear](https://infinitumboxing.online/product-category/mma-wears/): MMA and training apparel
- [Boxing glove size guide](https://infinitumboxing.online/boxing-glove-size-guide/): How to choose the right glove size for gyms and teams
